description: AI-assisted extraction: tries a plain HTTP fetch first and falls back to a full headless browser, returning content in the requested formats (html, markdown, links, screenshot, pdf). Best when you just want clean page content and do not know the right selectors. Example: browserless_smart_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", formats: ["markdown", "links"], _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Browserless API token (sign up at https://www.browserless.io/signup)

formats.description: Which formats to return: any of "html", "markdown", "links", "screenshot", "pdf" (default ["html"]). "content" (raw HTML/parsed JSON) is always returned.

name: browserless_smart_scrape
title: Browserless Smart Scrape
